items.title: Campbell Cuts Dividend, Tyson Slashes Outlook as Food Stocks Get Crushed

items.title: Prediction: Pepsi Stock Could Surprise Wall Street in 2027

Over the past year, PepsiCo’s share price return and its 1 year total shareholder return have both slipped slightly.
